⏳ GRAMMAR — Past Simple

🕵️ Exercise 8 — Classmate interview

Walk around and interview your classmates about last weekend. Write down the answers and report your findings.

Example: Did you watch TV last weekend?
Alex went to a movie and read a book. He didn’t watch TV and he didn’t ride his bike.

✍️ WRITING — Exercise 10

Read about Nick’s hobby. Write about what you like doing.

I like playing tennis. I play in the park near our house every weekend. Sometimes I play with my brother, and sometimes with my friend. I started playing tennis when I was eight. I didn’t like it at first, because it was hard, but now I enjoy doing it. It’s exciting when you win.

Write about your favourite hobby: what you like, where and when you do it, who you do it with, and why you enjoy it.

Sentence starters: I like... / I usually... / Sometimes I... / I started... / I enjoy it because...
